text:
Jamie: Morning — quick standup. What I did: finished the draft spec for 'weighted routing' (v0). Put it in the docs folder.
Jamie: Blockers: need QPS targets from infra to pick batching/instance sizes; also waiting on a final decision about fallback model variants.
Sam: Can you drop the spec link? I'll skim and leave CR comments.
Jamie: https://redwood.atlassian.net/links/WR-710 (draft) — main areas: routing policy, fallback order, metrics to track.
Alex: I can run a perf sweep on a small cluster today. Which model variant should I prioritize? small-quant or base-fp16?
Jamie: Start with small-quant for cost baseline, then base-fp16 for latency. If infra QPS suggests we can batch, test longer seqs.
Priya: I'll own the rollout plan once specs are stable. Plan: canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error-rate or latency spike. Need a list of metrics and alert thresholds.
Maya: UX note — when fallback happens we should surface a subtle banner in the console and include a telemetry flag for A/B. Added acceptance criteria to the spec doc.
Sam: CR: left inline comments about the fallback ordering. Tiny nit on terminology.
Jamie: Thanks Sam. Can someone ping infra for QPS numbers? tagging @Alex-infra (cc Alex here)
Alex: I'll ping infra and run a quick synthetic. Expect numbers back in ~2 hours.
DeployBot: CI pipeline red for branch feature/weighted-routing — tests failing: integration::router::fallback_spec (flaky). See CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/12345
Jamie: Ugh, flaky test. Sam — can you take a look or should I open a quick debug branch?
Sam: I'll triage the failure now. If flaky, I'll re-run and annotate the test with :flake: until we stabilize.
Priya: If the test indicates non-deterministic fallback, that affects rollout gating — add recovery timeout rules to the spec.
Maya: Quick heads-up: UX team has a slot this afternoon to review the banner copy. If we change the signal name, let me know before 3pm.
Jamie: Plan for today: 1) address Sam's CRs, 2) get infra QPS, 3) Alex runs perf, 4) triage CI flake, 5) finalize rollout thresholds with Priya.
Alex: On it. I'll post perf summary in this thread when done.
Sam: Re-run CI now. If it flakes again I'll open an issue and mark it flaky.
DeployBot: CI pipeline passed on re-run (build 12346) :party:
Jamie: Nice. Thanks team — I'll update the spec with rollout thresholds after Alex's numbers land. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
